Municipal Data Provenance

All records are directly retrieved from the City of Chicago Open Data Portal (SODA 2.0 API endpoint resource/ydr8-5enu.json) pursuant to the Illinois Freedom of Information Act (5 ILCS 140) and Municipal Open Data Ordinance.

Zero PII Guarantee

Data encompasses purely public corporate filings: licensed business entity names, permit classifications, jobsite addresses, and reported structural valuations. No personal emails, consumer credit data, or private residential phone numbers are ingested or provided.

3. Municipal Source Attribution & FOIA Disclaimer

All building permit filings, declared valuations, contractor classifications, and project descriptions originate from the City of Chicago Department of Buildings public repository under the terms of the Illinois Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) and the City of Chicago Open Data Ordinance.

While our automated pipelines perform validation, deduplication, and address cleaning, records reflect disclosures made by applicants to the municipality. Chicago Commercial Permits Intelligence is not responsible for delayed municipal postings, applicant reporting errors, or subsequent municipal permit revocations.

Chicago Commercial Permits Intelligence is an independent private commercial intelligence publication and is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the City of Chicago.

4. Privacy Policy & Cookieless Data Standards

This website does not deploy tracking cookies, advertising beacons, canvas fingerprinting, or persistent profiling tokens. In compliance with European Union ePrivacy Directive (Directive 2002/58/EC Art. 5(3)) and the GDPR, no cookie consent banner is legally required.

Payment Processing & MoR: All monetary transactions, credit card handling, tax calculation, and invoicing are conducted by Polar.sh acting as Merchant of Record. Polar.sh operates under strict PCI-DSS Level 1 compliance. We do not store, view, or process complete credit card numbers on our infrastructure.

Customer email addresses submitted during checkout are utilized exclusively for weekly delivery of the dataset and direct billing communication. Email addresses are never sold, rented, or shared with third-party advertising brokers.

5. Acceptable Use Policy & Zero PII Declaration

Chicago Commercial Permits Intelligence is an economic market research and preconstruction analytics publication classified under NAICS 541990 (Market Research & Analytics) and MCC 7372 (Data Processing Services).

Zero PII Guarantee: This service compiles exclusively public municipal filings concerning licensed corporate commercial entities, corporate general contractors, and commercial properties. We do not harvest, process, enrich, or distribute personally identifiable information (PII), consumer data, private residential phone numbers, or individual personal emails.

Acceptable Use & Prohibited Activities: Subscribers are strictly prohibited from utilizing this dataset for: (a) automated unsolicited telemarketing or robocalls, (b) mass unsolicited commercial email campaigns in violation of CAN-SPAM, CASL, or GDPR, or (c) reselling or sublicensing the records as a contact broker directory.
